bottlenecks.headline: Cash runs tight
bottlenecks.detail: Cash runs out even after the line of credit on about 1 days; interest costs about $953 a year.

bottlenecks.headline: Crews are paid for idle time
bottlenecks.detail: 33.9% of paid hours are neither on site nor driving. Idle time above a normal 10.0% costs up to about $185,448 a year in wages and burden (an estimate from accounting data).

bottlenecks.headline: Crews run out of hours
bottlenecks.detail: 53.9% of the work left undone at the end of a workday was waiting because crews had no time left. Jobs cancelled for this reason are worth up to about $7,320 of revenue a year (an estimate from accounting data, not a guaranteed gain).

bottlenecks.headline: Weather pushes work back
bottlenecks.detail: 46.0% of the work left undone at the end of a workday was waiting because weather stopped the work. Jobs cancelled for this reason are worth up to about $6,240 of revenue a year (an estimate from accounting data, not a guaranteed gain).
